status_rules.implemented_verified: All clauses of this written row's criterion have evidence for the stated current source and explicit observation scope. A recording/retention criterion does not supply unavailable scientific labels.
status_rules.implemented_pending_verification: Relevant implementation or candidate exists, but a material current row-matched operational or semantic observation is absent or failed.
status_rules.incomplete: A material required implementation, formal design, executed study, measurement or latest-version delivery artifact is missing. This label does not mean every related component is unbuilt.
status_rules.external_condition: The row's remaining substantive endpoint needs an unavailable human participant/reviewer or physical environment; independent engineering continues.
status_rules.unknown: Available evidence is insufficient even to determine the row's implementation/acceptance state. Absence of an original-task mapping alone is not this state.
